prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: standalone chapter illustration for a refined Hong Kong flute knowledge website.
Style: sophisticated literary arts journal editorial illustration, handmade paper grain, charcoal linework and matte gouache, quiet observational detail, evocative rather than technical.
Composition: wide 3:2 landscape, beautifully balanced with breathing room and natural asymmetry. No border.
Palette: deep forest green and near-black ink, warm cream paper, restrained copper accents, realistic silver when a flute is shown.
Constraints: no people or body parts, no text or captions, no logos or watermarks, no readable notation, no fake historical documents, no invented anatomical or instructional diagrams. Any visible flute must be recognizable as a modern Western concert flute. Keep instrument details plausible and unobtrusive.
Subject: An empty chamber music rehearsal room with one grand piano and exactly two music stands, with simple chairs arranged to face each other for listening and playing together. No people. Oblique view across the room, cream acoustic walls, warm wood floor and restrained forest-green upholstery. Soft daytime light. Quiet collaboration suggested by the arrangement, fine charcoal lines and subtle gouache on paper.

origin.editPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied illustration only. Remove the tiny gold wordmark/lettering on the front of the piano so that surface is completely plain. Remove the entire silver flute from the green chair at right, restoring uninterrupted upholstery. Keep every other object, the two music stands, all chairs, grand piano geometry, room, style, colours, paper texture, lighting and wide 3:2 framing unchanged. No new objects, no new text or logos.
